name: The Athenee Hotel
positioning: The Athenee Hotel, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Bangkok: a city hotel on Wireless Road in Bangkok's embassy and business district, built on the site of a royal palace and designed in a Thai-Colonial style
best_for: Travelers drawn to Thai royal history and heritage design
City stays with a rooftop garden pool and a spa
Families wanting a kids' pool and children's touches in central Bangkok

facts.text: The hotel is in Bangkok's embassy and business district.
The hotel is flanked by embassies on tree-lined Wireless Road.
The hotel is a short walk from Phloen Chit BTS Skytrain station.
Rooms combine local Thai art, handcrafted accessories and original antiques.
Rooms have a marble bathroom with a separate bathtub and rain shower.
Ratanakosin is a two-bedroom suite with Thai silks.
The Athenee butler service includes unpacking and packing luggage, shoe shining and garment pressing.
The rooftop pool is shaded by native trees and blossoming plants.
Guests can take sunrise yoga sessions in the Sky Garden.
Guests can train in Muay Thai with an instructor in the Sky Garden.
The House of Smooth Curry has 1920s decor, art and a private spice garden with terrace dining.
The Silk Road puts a modern twist on traditional Cantonese cuisine.

highlights.text: The hotel was built on the site of Kandhavas, the palace of Princess Valaya Alongkorn.
The free-form, lagoon-style pool sits in a rooftop garden with views of the Bangkok skyline.
The hotel's design brings back the Thai-Colonial style of Princess Valaya Alongkorn's era.
Athenee Spa fuses French stylings with the mystique of Siam.
A complimentary heritage experience lets guests wear Thai dress while exploring the heritage of Kandhavas Palace.

considerations.text: The Royal Club Lounge is reserved for Club Room and Suite guests.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a busy commercial district with an urban atmosphere.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
